summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Sagicor Progress Dashboard. All 8 dashboard sections render correctly with accurate data. Preview route works without auth, public route shows email gate. Proposals page card links correctly. Fixed prop name bug in SagicorProgressDashboardPublic.jsx (presentationTitle → proposalTitle).

issues: Minor horizontal overflow (~24px) detected on mobile (390px) and tablet (768px) viewports. Does not significantly impact usability but could be improved with additional responsive CSS.
